Chip design is so labor-intensive and costly that engineering teams can spend up to 70% of ⁠their time writing and ‌testing code, and analysts say AI-powered productivity boosts are critical for the U.S. to maintain its technological edge. The agent looks at a chip's design, builds a "mental model" of how the chip is supposed to work, and then can use various ​Cadence tools to test the design and fix bugs.
